title: Accepted Atlas cumulative gate funnel
extraction_rule: Recount recorded accepted-cell fields using frozen gate predicates; gate counts checked against report. Gate 3 requires finite, non-null mean_excess in every declared regime, with mean_excess * full-cell excess_mean > 0; null or unavailable regime fails rather than being skipped or converted to zero. Gate 4 requires max_date_share <= 0.10 and max_symbol_share <= 0.05; gate 5 requires fillable_count >= required_sample_size. Zero formal nominations transcribed from report, because nominations require separate governance.

study_context.universe: liquid cash and point-in-time F&O membership lenses
study_context.instrument: cash-price base rates in both lenses
study_context.benchmark: same eligible equal-weight universe and horizon
study_context.costs: No actual-instrument cost clearance in Atlas; rough magnitude is diagnostic only
study_context.inference: recorded date/symbol two-way clustering; BH across all accepted cells; BY diagnostic
study_context.source_verdict: discovery atlas complete; no cell formally nominated

caveats: Cells overlap across states and horizons; counts are not independent alpha discoveries.
Gates 6–7 (actual-instrument costs/translation and mechanism) were not automated.
Formal nominations are a report transcription, not inferred from cell statistics.
Unopened holdout is Atlas-specific; the calendar dates were used by other research families.
